reels.title: Alice Huang tied to Nvidia's biggest Chinese competitor
reels.summary:
Alice Huang, with whom ousted Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang reportedly had a romantic relationship, has owned stakes in companies that have benefited Huawei, Nvidia’s no. 1 competitor in China.

The entanglement has not been previously reported and was first uncovered by private intelligence firm Tesari and shared exclusively with CNBC.
